products.name: TruLens
products.note: Open-source LLM evaluation via feedback functions; RAG Triad of groundedness, context relevance, answer relevance; OpenTelemetry tracing

profile_text.body:
TruLens is an open-source evaluation and tracing library for AI agents, hosted at trulens.org and associated with TruEra and Snowflake. The project describes itself as instrumenting AI agents with OpenTelemetry, scoring every step with benchmarked LLM judges, and identifying which version of an agent to ship. The site states that TruLens finds where an agent fails and where cost can be reduced without losing quality.

On the product side, TruLens is categorized as an AI governance and risk management platform. It uses feedback functions to evaluate large language models and applies what the project calls the RAG Triad, a set of three measures covering groundedness, context relevance, and answer relevance. The library is described as OpenTelemetry-native and fully open source.

The held facts do not include litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations associated with this project.
